name: Fenn Alderwick
look: a lean, wiry man of about thirty with a narrow freckled face, long copper-red hair tied back with two thin braids hanging in front of his right ear, a short neat copper beard, and bright green eyes. He wears a moss-green hooded wool cloak fastened at the throat with a bronze oak-leaf brooch over a cream linen tunic and a brown leather herb-pouch belt, and carries a tall gnarled dark wooden staff whose top is a knot of roots gripping a rough amber stone
voice: a light, quick, bright tenor with a wry, precise, slightly amused delivery
personality: Clever, talkative, cautious, fond of being right and fonder of Brann than he lets on. Notices everything, warns about it, gets ignored, and enjoys saying so afterwards.
speech: Quick, complete, slightly fussy sentences. Dry teasing. Corrects details. Gets the last word.
voice_prompt: a light, quick, bright tenor voice, wry and amused

files.portrait: fenn_portrait.webp (hero reference, use for every still)
files.sheet: fenn_sheet.webp (full body, three views; add for full-body and back shots)
files.voice_sample: voice.mp3 (14 s; shared by public link for models that take a voice recording, e.g. Seedance: refer to it as @Audio1 and name whose voice it is)

voice_sample_made_with: bytedance-seed/seed-audio-1-0, voice described in the text prompt
how_to_use: Stills: pass portrait (and sheet) as reference images and repeat the `look` text. Video with dialogue: write the line as: <tag>, says in <voice_prompt>: "...". Keep `look`, `voice_prompt` and tag wording identical between films.
tag: Fenn, the lean red-haired man in the green cloak
relationship: Brann and Fenn are old friends and adventuring partners who bicker constantly.
voice_archetype: wry light-tenor clever one (lean, young, quick)
casting_rule: The look largely decides the voice a video model gives a character, so two characters of the same look type will sound alike. No two characters in one production may share a voice archetype; on a clash, change the look or age of one before any shot is rendered.
